status: v0.1 — informed by BeyondC + IDhair Figma and three local source projects

rules.spacing: Use the 4px scale for layout spacing. Borders, optical logo adjustments and decorative artwork may use documented exceptions.
rules.type: Use semantic roles. Body stays 16px; captions 12px minimum. Display typography is an intentional exception to fixed-size type roles.
rules.responsive: Adjust grid and spacing at 600px / 1024px; fluid headings use clamp. Breakpoints are shared rules, not CSS custom properties.
rules.figma: 12 structural columns on all viewports, desktop content 1440px at 1560px frame (60px sides), mobile sides 20px. Visual cards may span 12 or 6 columns. Text families remain project-specific; measured source styles are preserved in figma-audit.json.
rules.motion: Text masks reveal upward once on entering viewport; 55ms word stagger capped at 440ms; keep a single accessible phrase. Respect OS reduced motion and explicit Motion off. No scroll hijacking; pointer effects only on fine pointers.
